occurrences.text: Rules, lockups, marks and checks carry numbers so a reviewer can cite R5 instead of describing it.
R1 Newsprint at 60 to 85 percent. One dark beat per section.
R2 One object at display scale or one red emphasis.
R3 Stone hairlines. No boxes, no cards, no shadows.
R5 Red does one job. Identity marks exempt. No partisan red and blue pairing. No red against green.
R6 Grid in a sanctioned position at a sanctioned size. One red node at most. Rules A to F decode correctly.
R7 Clear space, minimum size and export size on the artwork.
R8 Every statistic sourced. Illustrative figures labeled.
